project_info.color_palette: Light blue, white, navy, coral red, soft teal

main_subject.detail: A clean recruitment poster with the Toyota logo at top left and the headline 'BANG TIN TUYEN DUNG TOYOTA VIET NAM'. The central deadline text reads 'HAN NHAN HO SO 25/7/2026' with the note '(Co the ket thuc som hon du kien)'. Below are three flat-style illustrated office professionals: one holding a giant magnifying glass, one holding a briefcase while looking through a telescope, and one holding a laptop. The pastel background contains large translucent gear shapes and abstract blue organic forms. Bottom-right script says 'Move your world'.
